create_masked_dataset: create a LanguagePairSelfDatasetMask instance with source and target datasets for masked language modeling
collate_samples: collate a list of sample dicts into a mini-batch tensor dict with src_tokens and target
make_source_target: call _make_source_target on a LanguagePairSelfDatasetMask to apply random token masking to target sequences
get_dummy_batch: get a dummy batch from a LanguagePairSelfDatasetMask with specified num_tokens and max_positions
ordered_indices: get ordered indices from a LanguagePairSelfDatasetMask sorted by source and target sentence sizes
